corridors.name: Pointe-Noire ↔ Pointe-Indienne
corridors.waypoint_guidance: Round the Pointe-Noire headland offshore, then run the coast north to Pointe-Indienne.

corridors.name: Pointe-Noire Bay ↔ Côte Sauvage
corridors.waypoint_guidance: Short sheltered bay hop; no land crossing.

vessel_gate_rule: <=70nm Pioneer II solid; 75-150nm Quanta-LR amber-dashed; >150nm review
_vessel_gate_note: Range-gated by hull. Long legs never faked on a 70nm boat.
